title: No more mid-session disconnects
body: No more mid-session disconnects: the idle watchdog is now OFF by default, so the daemon stays up across client blips instead of auto-exiting and tearing down your browsers. Opt back into auto-quit with OCTOWRIGHT_IDLE_GRACE on CI/shared hosts.

title: Reconnects are seamless
body: Reconnects are seamless: a detached daemon reliably stays alive after a client disconnects (no more fragile inline-mode fallback), and --keep-alive now actually reaches the daemon it's meant to govern.

title: No more orphaned serve processes
body: No more orphaned `octowright serve` processes: a follower hard-exits when its MCP client closes stdin, instead of lingering and reconnecting forever.
